results.content:
Deno 2.8 is here. This is our biggest minor release to date and we’re excited to share it with you.

To upgrade to Deno 2.8, run the following in your terminal:

```
deno upgrade
```

If Deno is not yet installed, run one of the following commands to install or [learn how to install it here](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/manual/getting_started/installation).

```
# Using Shell (macOS and Linux):
curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh

# Using PowerShell (Windows):
iwr https://deno.land/ins
